paragraphs: Here's what I want you to hold onto, friend: the LORD keeps His promises, down to the last detail. Joshua 21:45 says, "Not one of all the LORD's good promises to the house of Israel had failed; everything was fulfilled." Not one, not most of them, ALL of them. The land, the rest, the cities for the Levites, every bit of it.

And look at how this chapter shows it. The Levites had no land of their own (Joshua 18:7), and the LORD still commanded that they be given cities to live in and pasturelands for their livestock (Joshua 21:2-3). Forty-eight cities in all, handed out by lot, clan by clan, so every Levite family had its place (Joshua 21:4-8, 41). If you ever feel like your share got lost in the shuffle, this chapter shows a God who keeps His word to people who had no land.

So here's what it means for you today. Joshua 21:43 says the LORD gave Israel all the land He had sworn to give their fathers, and verse 44 says He gave them rest on every side. The promise was made long before they ever stood in that land, and He kept it anyway. So when you're waiting on something God has said, keep your oven warm, friend, because this God finishes what He promises.
